text:
Avi: dropped a new prototype for the rollout timeline — condensed rows, left-floating action cluster, and a compact version picker. figma: https://figma.redwood/rollout/timeline-condensed-v3
Avi: intent: let PMs scan history quickly and flip small A/B experiments without leaving the list. open questions: accessibility and microcopy for the inline actions.
Jun: quick flag: if action cluster is left-floating we must preserve logical reading order. For screen reader users the row should read: name, status, percent, actions. If we visually place actions first, SR users will hear actions before context.
Kara: agree. Suggest DOM order = name -> status -> percent -> actions. Use CSS transform to visually move actions left. Also include an offscreen description element summarizing the row state ("Variant X: running, 3%").
Devon: implementation note: we need to ensure focus outlines are not clipped when actions are visually left. Our current condensed-row CSS sets overflow hidden which clips ring. We can add outline-offset or increase visible padding.
Avi: thanks. Microcopy: should the action button be "Start canary" or "Enable experiment"? Product asks for explicit verbs with the variant name. I'm leaning "Start canary — Checkout V2". Thoughts?
Kara: explicit is better. But long labels will push layout. For compact rows, show icon + short label "Start" and aria-label full text "Start canary for Checkout V2 (3% traffic)".
Jun: good pattern. Also we should use aria-live polite to announce when a canary starts: "Canary started for Checkout V2, 3% traffic". Make sure live region text is updated after confirmation.
Devon: undo pattern: I recommend toast undo + persistent timeline entry that shows the event with a rollback button. Inline undo will bloat rows. Toast should be focusable for keyboard users — include a "View details" link in the toast that moves focus to the timeline item.
Avi: focus move behavior: stay on the triggering control after action. Don't steal focus to toast. But make the toast reachable and announceable.
Sam: telemetry: emit event names: rollout_triggered_intent and rollout_triggered_confirmed. Include fields: variant_id, previous_percent, new_percent, user_agent, method: "ui". Also capture whether a confirmation modal was shown.
Kara: confirmation modals: if a rollout requires extra approvals, the toggle should open a non-blocking drawer with checklist instead of immediate action. Drawer must have aria-modal if it traps focus, and heading announced on open.
Jun: keyboard nav: ensure action cluster is reachable via single tab stop per row (use a composite button that opens action menu) rather than three separate tab stops, to speed scanning. Use arrow keys within the menu for locality.
Devon: small css ask: increase hit target of icons to 44px and add visible focus ring color that passes contrast. Our brand focus teal at 3.8:1 is failing; Sam can we get a 4.5:1 focus color token?
Sam: I'll add a higher-contrast focus token and run checks on the badge/disabled states. Also confirm telemetry schema.
qa-bot: checklist added to ticket RW-4890: keyboard order, screen reader label, live region announcement, undo toast focusability, telemetry fields present.
Avi: decisions so far: DOM order preserved, visual left-floating actions, toast + timeline rollback, explicit copy via aria-label on compact buttons, single-tabper-row action with menu for extra actions.
Kara: I'll update the comp to show the action menu pattern and include aria attributes. Avi: can you add the compact-button states (default/pressed/loading) in the frame?
Avi: yes — will add states and a short tab-flow video. Due tomorrow.
